start: Member trained at least once in each of the last 3 weeks (Monday to Sunday), including this week

user_sees: Card 'Rest days' with days since the last workout
The same 3 weeks in a row
must_not: A different streak number on another screen

start: Brand-new member with no workouts, and a member whose last workout was 3 weeks ago

steps.action: Open History as the new member
must_not: NaN, a minus number or a blank card

steps.action: Open History as the member who stopped 3 weeks ago
must_not: The old streak still shown as alive

start: Member with workouts last week, none yet this week

user_sees: The streak still counts last week's run (alive while this week is empty)
must_not: The streak drops to 0 before this week is over

steps.action: Finish a workout this week, open History
user_sees: The streak goes up by one
must_not: The streak counts two workouts in one week as two weeks

steps.action: Delete that only workout of this week
must_not: A streak that still counts the deleted workout

start: Member with a 5-week run, at the end of the year

steps.action: Open the year in review report
must_not: A longest streak that disagrees with the weeks-in-a-row rule
